programs.title: Road absurdities 4
programs.desc:
In the next series, Kamil Jaśkowski and Krzysztof Ruszała continue their developing trips around Poland, during which they look for the causes of various absurd road solutions.Using a prototype siren with the mysterious symbol S201, they will go to places where officials lightly spent huge amounts of money on non-functional communication infrastructure facilities.A bicycle path with pedestrian crossings every few meters, a speed limit for only one lane, a "zebra" right behind the "parking" sign, poles at the entrances to the garage, a street lamp in the middle of the road - this is just the beginning of the list of topics that tireless hunters of road stupidity will face.
Kamil and Krzysiek will go to Warsaw by Mermaid from Kutno, where they will look at the constructions in Żoliborz resembling a city race track and try to count the cones on the Toruńska Route and on the Hel Coast near the zoo.The next stop is Żyrardów: the bicycle path ends there so that road users are at risk of a head-on collision, and a wrongly set speed limit sign near the cemetery means that you can drive at 40 km/h in one direction and 50 km/h in the other.In Łódź, our attention will be drawn to complicated methods of limiting speed, too short a left turn that makes it difficult to exit the roundabout during rush hours, and an intersection that pretends to be a roundabout.

programs.title: Road absurdities 4
programs.desc:
In the next series, Kamil Jaśkowski and Krzysztof Ruszała continue their developing trips around Poland, during which they look for the causes of various absurd road solutions.Using a prototype siren with the mysterious symbol S201, they will go to places where officials lightly spent huge amounts of money on non-functional communication infrastructure facilities.A bicycle path with pedestrian crossings every few meters, a speed limit for only one lane, a "zebra" right behind the "parking" sign, poles at the entrances to the garage, a street lamp in the middle of the road - this is just the beginning of the list of topics that tireless hunters of road stupidity will face.
In Zgierz we will see a pole at the entrance to the garage, in Łowicz - the intersection of a pedestrian crossing with a parking lot, in Łódź - the original exit from the parking lot which is the main road, and in Karczew - a pedestrian crossing at the exit of two access roads.In Warsaw, Kamil and Krzysiek will try to read the small print on the sign under the sign while driving at the legal speed of 70 km/h, they will evaluate the use of an innovative safe end solution, they will visit a bicycle path with occasional pedestrian crossings, they will look for the reason for blocking three parking spaces in the center, and in Rembertów they will encounter a pole in the middle of the road.
